'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeffrey Johns DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' "Winter Wonderland"
* '''Username:''' jademasters
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
